title: Import a PDF fixture through the Test Bridge

preconditions: Workspace is open with the Library route active.

steps.description: Inject a fixture PDF via the Test Bridge so the scenario stays deterministic and bypasses the file picker. The bridge command completes synchronously once the paper is persisted and the library reloaded. Debug-only; see Proposal-AT.md P-AT.1e.

assertions.description: Library list rendered without SwiftUI runtime warnings (P-AT.1d).
